title: Zeeroz Academy Academic Coverage Master Plan

scope.principle: Use the current applicable Sindh curriculum, official scheme of studies and available Sindh Textbook Board books. Distinguish verified compulsory subjects, group/elective subjects and Academy enrichment. Do not mark planned content as published.

official_sources.use: Current textbooks by grade and medium; confirm edition and subject availability before chapter sequencing.

official_sources.use: Schemes of studies, teaching licence policy and assessment frameworks.

official_sources.use: Notifications, approvals and NOCs for revised curricula.

course_components: worked examples and numericals where relevant

pathways.note: Confirm the current notified scheme and board-specific subject combination before assigning a subject to a grade or group.
These are planning pathways, not a claim that every college offers every group or elective. Verify current scheme, college availability and the relevant board.

chapter: Chapter overview and measurable learning outcomes
Original, student-friendly lesson notes aligned to the verified syllabus
Relevant labelled diagrams, maps, tables or illustrations with attribution
Worked examples, numericals or real-life applications where appropriate
Practice MCQs with four options, answer key and explanation
CRQs with model answers and marking points
ERQs with structured model answers and marking rubrics
Chapter review, mixed practice and assessment

assessment.mcq: Four plausible options, one defensible correct answer, explanation and topic tag.
assessment.crq: Short constructed-response question, model answer and marks/marking points.
assessment.erq: Extended response, structured model answer, expected evidence and marking rubric.
assessment.quality: Check factual accuracy, syllabus relevance, grade suitability, answer-key correctness, duplication and accessibility.

publishing_rules: A subject is not complete until every verified syllabus unit has lessons and all required question types.
Keep each GitHub course package within the existing safe importer record limit; split large subjects into chapter-wise courses when needed.
Do not copy full copyrighted textbook passages. Write original explanations and link to official books.
Only use educational images with a checked source and suitable reuse terms; include attribution.
Do not invent official syllabus references, page numbers, marks distributions or examination patterns.
GitHub deployment and Firebase import are separate steps. Firebase course sync requires an authorised administrator session unless a verified free automation path is implemented.
The free Firebase Spark plan remains the target; do not enable paid billing or rely on paid APIs.

verified_curriculum_maps.subject: Biology
verified_curriculum_maps.curriculum: Curriculum of Biology for Sindh Grades IX-XII (DCAR Sindh, 2024; aligned with NCP 2022-23)
verified_curriculum_maps.implementation_note: The existing Biology IX Chapter 1 package is not fully aligned to this 2024 chapter outline: its current lessons cover biology introduction, branches and interdisciplinary science but must be expanded to include the curriculum's Quranic view on development of life, careers in biological sciences and biological methods. The 2024 chapter sequence takes precedence over legacy textbook chapter ordering; verify STBB book edition and board exam notification before finalising exam-specific claims.

important_scope_correction: Do not assume every subject family is offered in every grade or every intermediate group. The current DCAR curriculum library and notified Scheme of Studies must determine the actual grade/group coverage. The STBB portal's book counts and editions differ by grade and language, so verify each title and edition individually.
